as_told.title: Plasma orbs at a heart-centred event with 30 people

plain: In 2024, during a group exercise meant to make contact at the Esalen Institute, a retreat centre on the coast at Big Sur, California, Jordan Jose says blue orbs of what he calls plasma rose out of the ocean and came within about 50 yards of the people there. Jose, who says he was there, tells Michels about it and mentions the journalist Ross Coulthart; when he returns to it later he speaks of about 30 people, all deeply heart-centred, without naming Esalen. He tells it as proof that a group's intent can draw these lights in.
